sentences.text: Hoy Sam quiere conocer la vida de doña Marta.
sentences.english: Today Sam wants to know the life of doña Marta.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Doña Marta, may I ask a question?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: Of course, Sam.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: What do you want to know?

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: How old are you?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: I am seventy years old.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Soy una mujer vieja, pero tengo el corazón joven.
sentences.english: I am an old woman, but I have a young heart.

sentences.text: Doña Marta nació en un pueblo pequeño cerca del mar.
sentences.english: Doña Marta was born in a small village near the sea.
She was born seventy years ago.

sentences.text: Su papá trabajó con el café, y su mamá cocinó pan.
sentences.english: Her father worked with coffee, and her mother baked bread.
Marta grew up in the village.

sentences.text: De niña, fue a la escuela y aprendió a leer.
sentences.english: As a girl, she went to school and learned to read.
She read the Bible.
She was a happy girl.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Was it easy to read the Bible?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: No, it was difficult.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Las palabras fueron diferentes, y no entendí todo.
sentences.english: The words were different, and I did not understand everything.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: But I kept going.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: Today it is easy for me.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Is it another language?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: No, es el idioma de siempre.
sentences.english: No, it is the usual language.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: But it is a different book.

sentences.text: Un día, Marta y su papá hicieron un viaje al mar.
sentences.english: One day, Marta and her father made a trip to the sea.

sentences.text: Subieron a un autobús y bajaron en la playa.
sentences.english: They got on a bus and got off at the beach.
It was a very good outing.
It was her first trip.

sentences.text: A los dieciocho años, Marta llevó su bolsa y subió a otro autobús.
sentences.english: At eighteen, Marta took her bag and got on another bus.
She got off in the city.

sentences.text: Allí trabajó en el centro y vendió pan.
sentences.english: There she worked downtown and sold bread.

sentences.text: Marta fue joven en la ciudad, y allí conoció a Miguel en un parque.
sentences.english: Marta was young in the city, and there she met Miguel in a park.

sentences.text: Miguel nació en la ciudad y creció allí.
sentences.english: Miguel was born in the city and grew up there.
He was a good man.

sentences.text: Miguel pidió la mano de Marta.
sentences.english: Miguel asked for Marta's hand.
Marta felt peace.

sentences.text: Miguel puso un regalo en la mesa.
sentences.english: Miguel put a present on the table.
They got married in church.

sentences.text: La fiesta fue grande, y la gente bailó hasta la noche.
sentences.english: The party was big, and the people danced until night.

sentences.text: Miguel fue su esposo, y Marta fue su esposa por cuarenta años.
sentences.english: Miguel was her husband, and Marta was his wife for forty years.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Did you get married in church?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Sí, me casé a la edad de veinte años.
sentences.english: Yes, I got married at the age of twenty.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: What was your husband like?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Fue un hombre bueno, y trabajó mucho.
sentences.english: He was a good man, and he worked a lot.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: I was a happy wife.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Ser esposa de Miguel fue un regalo de Dios.
sentences.english: Being Miguel's wife was a gift from God.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Mi esposo me llevó al mar.
sentences.english: My husband took me to the sea.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: It was a good moment.

sentences.text: Marta y Miguel tuvieron dos hijos: Ana y Luis.
sentences.english: Marta and Miguel had two children: Ana and Luis.

sentences.text: Ana y Luis crecieron en la casa de doña Marta.
sentences.english: Ana and Luis grew up in doña Marta's house.

sentences.text: Cuando Luis fue niño, jugó en el parque con Ana.
sentences.english: When Luis was a boy, he played in the park with Ana.
Miguel died eight years ago.
Doña Marta felt a lot of pain.
Before that, her father also died.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Was it hard, doña Marta?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: Yes, Sam.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: We all have to die.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Pero Dios quiere salvar y perdonar.
sentences.english: But God wants to save and to forgive.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Yo fui una oveja perdida, y Dios me buscó.
sentences.english: I was a lost sheep, and God looked for me.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Los ángeles de Dios cuidan a la gente.
sentences.english: God's angels take care of people.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: God is my king.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: He is the king of the world.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Yo alabo a Dios, y adoro a Dios.
sentences.english: I praise God, and I worship God.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: The glory is God's.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: God blesses my family.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: It is a miracle.

sentences.text: Hoy doña Marta tiene una casa, una familia y dos nietos.
sentences.english: Today doña Marta has a house, a family and two grandchildren.

sentences.text: Nico es un niño de diez años.
sentences.english: Nico is a boy of ten.

sentences.text: Su nieto es un cipote feliz.
sentences.english: Her grandson is a happy little boy.

sentences.text: La otra es una niña pequeña que vive lejos.
sentences.english: The other is a little girl who lives far away.

sentences.text: Doña Marta quiere mucho a sus nietos.
sentences.english: Doña Marta loves her grandchildren very much.

sentences.text: Los niños de la iglesia juegan en su casa los domingos.
sentences.english: The children from church play at her house on Sundays.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: How old is Nico?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: Ten years.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Y las mujeres de la iglesia me visitan.
sentences.english: And the women from church visit me.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Los hombres ayudan con la casa.
sentences.english: The men help with the house.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Los jóvenes traen pan y café.
sentences.english: The young people bring bread and coffee.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Una señora vieja me dio un regalo anteayer.
sentences.english: An old lady gave me a present the day before yesterday.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: The old people are good friends.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: I am a woman of God.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: I am no longer alone.
Doña Marta went back to the village.

sentences.text: Fue una visita buena, un lugar diferente.
sentences.english: It was a good visit, a different place.

sentences.text: El último día, doña Marta oró y dijo: "Gracias, Dios."
sentences.english: On the last day, doña Marta prayed and said: "Thank you, God."

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Thank you, doña Marta.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: I am going to write your life.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: Of course, Sam.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Anteayer Nico me dijo: "Abuela, su vida es un libro."
sentences.english: The day before yesterday Nico told me: "Grandmother, your life is a book."

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Maybe, doña Marta.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: I am sure of it.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: ¿Es posible escribir toda su vida en un libro?
sentences.english: Is it possible to write your whole life in a book?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Es difícil, pero claro que sí.
sentences.english: It is hard, but of course.

sentences.text: Sam escribe todo el fin de semana.
sentences.english: Sam writes all weekend.

sentences.text: Es un libro pequeño, pero es una vida grande.
sentences.english: It is a small book, but it is a big life.
